from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=df['t'].values;P=df['P'].values;y=df['dP_dt'].values
def D(p):
    w=p[10]
    base=(p[0]+p[1]*np.tanh(p[2]*t)) + (p[3]+p[4]*np.tanh(p[5]*t))*P + (p[6]+p[7]*np.tanh(p[8]*t))*P**2 + p[9]*P**3
    return base + (p[11]+p[12]*P)*np.sin(w*t)+(p[13]+p[14]*P)*np.cos(w*t)

    try:
        r=least_squares(lambda q: D(q)-y, p0, max_nfev=3000)
        if bestall is None or r.cost<bestall.cost: bestall=r
